reason: I travel twice a month and always leave pills at home, so a counted sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits my life. The named lab and the batch report make me comfortable enough to try one box at the launch price.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? Magnesium is subtle and I could finish 30 sachets and not be sure it did anything.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report turned out not to match my batch number, or the box showed no clear dose, I would pass.
